course.title: Unit 3 Where did you go?-Part A--【例句】
course.description: Part A（What happened? Where did you go?）

sentences.content: What happened? I fell off my bike last Saturday and hurt my foot.
sentences.english: What happened ? I fell off my bike last Saturday and hurt my foot
sentences.chinese: 发生什么事了？上周六我从自行车上摔下来，伤到了脚。

sentences.content: Are you all right? I’m OK now.
sentences.english: Are you all right ? I'm OK now
sentences.chinese: 你还好吗？我现在没事了。

sentences.content: Where did you go over the Labour Day holiday? Mt. Tianshan, Xinjiang.
sentences.english: Where did you go over the Labour Day holiday ? Mt . Tianshan , Xinjiang
sentences.chinese: 劳动节假期你去哪儿了？新疆的天山。

sentences.content: I rode a horse. It looks like a mule!
sentences.english: I rode a horse . It looks like a mule !
sentences.chinese: 我骑了一匹马。它看起来像头骡子！

wordDetails.definition: look（第三人称单数现在式）: 看起来

sentences.content: Did you go to Turpan? Yes, we did. We saw lots of grapes.
sentences.english: Did you go to Turpan ? Yes , we did . We saw lots of grapes
sentences.chinese: 你们去吐鲁番了吗？是的，我们去了。我们看到了很多葡萄。
